about_the_game:
Dive into Defendrion, a top-down, wave-survival action game where you step into the boots of Raven, an arcane spellcaster on a mission to reclaim her homeland from an onslaught of nightmarish creatures. From the eerie halls of the Forsaken Keep to the glowing crystal caverns of the Obsidian Realm, every environment is crafted to immerse you in a dark, atmospheric fantasy world.

Key Features

  • Unleash Devastating Spells: You can upgrade your spells and make them stronger.

  • Endless PvE Waves: Face increasingly challenging enemy waves—test your reflexes and strategy to climb the leaderboards.

  • Cinematic Spell FX: High-fidelity particle effects and dynamic lighting make every cast feel weighty and impactful.

Master Raven’s magic, survive the darkness, and become the ultimate spellcaster.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later (Universal: Apple Silicon & Intel)
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio–compatible, stereo (5.1 supported)
  • Additional Notes: Native Apple Silicon support; also runs on Intel via Rosetta 2
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple M2
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio–compatible, stereo (5.1 supported)

name: Defendrion Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (2 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible, 5.1 surround supported
